selected_evidence.requirement: node1<->node2 traffic keeps flowing unaffected while mirroring is active
selected_evidence.summary: Ping from node1 to node2 over the seg interfaces shows 0% packet loss both before mirroring was configured and repeatedly afterward, including after all three node restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-mirroring baseline: node3 does not naturally see node1<->node2 traffic (proves segment is switched, motivates need for mirroring)
selected_evidence.summary: tcpdump on node3's enp8s0 during a node1->node2 ping captured 0 packets.

selected_evidence.requirement: A capture on node3 shows node1<->node2 traffic, addressed elsewhere, once mirroring is configured
selected_evidence.summary: tcpdump on node3's mirr0 (gretap decap interface) captured all 8 ICMP packets between 192.168.50.1 (node1) and 192.168.50.2 (node2), not addressed to node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mirror mechanism configuration (GRETAP tunnel + tc flower filters) on node1 and node3
selected_evidence.summary: mirr0 gretap link created and up on both node1 and node3; tc clsact filters on node1's eth1 mirroring ingress/egress traffic matched on node2's IP (plus ARP) into mirr0.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured on every node (boot identity, service/interface state)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, seg-mirror.service state, and seg interface/mirr0 state on node1, node2, node3 prior to any restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returns, boot identity changes, service/mirroring recovers
selected_evidence.summary: systemd reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed 8e8823ec->a22699da; seg-mirror.service initially failed (journalctl showed 'Parent Qdisc doesn't exists' due to a flawed idempotency check), script was fixed and restarted, and end-to-end mirroring was re-verified working via ping + tcpdump on node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement returns, boot identity changes, seg connectivity recovers
selected_evidence.summary: systemd reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed 6bb7e004->43a4b008; enp8s0 seg IP present and ping to node1 succeeded (0% loss) post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement returns, boot identity changes, mirror receiver recovers
selected_evidence.summary: systemd reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed bf4e9cbb->0ee30735; seg-mirror.service active and mirr0 recreated automatically; final end-to-end test confirmed node3's tcpdump on mirr0 again captured node1<->node2 ping traffic while the ping itself had 0% loss.
